text_block_list.text:

Thank you, I finally get it~.

text_block_list.text:
I've just been spacing out a lot lately...
Even what's in the textbooks won't really stick in my head.

text_block_list.text: If only you could read to me like old times... Just kidding.

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Yeah, it really is weird, huh.
Haaah...

text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is letting out sighs.
Fatigue might be catching up to her.
Let's reconsider her racing schedule a bit.
